learning_outcomes.text: Recognition of Career Centers and Their Activities: Ensuring that students are aware of the services offered by the Career Center and establishing a connection between the Career Center and the student.

Increasing Self-Awareness: Ensuring the student learns concepts such as intelligence, personality, knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies, and establishes the connection of these concepts with career.

Exploring Career Options: Enabling students to recognize sectors such as public sector, private sector, academia, and non-governmental organizations, grasp the differences between sectors, and see working life in these sectors.
Developing Soft Skills: Increasing awareness about the importance of developing soft skills in the career process.
Discovering Activities that Can Contribute to Career Planning: Informing students about activities outside of their lessons that can contribute to their careers throughout their university life.

Recognition of International Exchange Programs: Ensuring students gain awareness about the contributions of international exchange programs to personal development and academic life, and their positive reflections on career plans.

syllabus_topics: COURSE EVALUATION *In this course, students will evaluate the course with the evaluation form prepared by the Presidential Human Resources Office.
